info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v4-spec
info.description: The Delivery ETA Retrieval API provides businesses with the ability to obtain estimated delivery times for their food delivery services. This API allows users to query delivery estimates based on specific parameters, offering precise timing for orders in transit. Typical consumers include food delivery platforms, restaurants, and logistics operators who need dynamic tracking capabilities to enhance customer satisfaction. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve their operational efficiency and provide real-time updates to customers.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to obtain the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for specific deliveries. It is useful for tracking and managing delivery schedules effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters necessary for calculating the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for a delivery. It should include relevant information such as delivery details and specifications.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasRequest.description: Represents the request body for the operations related to delivery ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) when making a GET request.
